title: Cross-Golden Consistency
description: When the same skill is validated against multiple goldens, verify verdicts and mutation patterns are coherent across templates. Diverging behavior may indicate template-shape divergence.

requirements.title: Cross-golden verdict comparator
requirements.description: Service that, per skill, groups latest verdicts across all goldens and flags divergent patterns (pass on A, unexpected-mutation on B; same paths mutated differently across templates).
